summary: Most consequential: the postpartum onset test in the Urgent rule is reversed (<= time_ago 1 weeks selects patients MORE than a week postpartum), and the giant cell arteritis rule drops the page's 'Patient > 50 years' condition. Also meningitis signs reach the Urgent rule only via active_condition Meningitis, and migraine/tension rules lack the page's branch gating. Remaining claims are mostly faithful with minor qualifier losses (nausea dropped, 'asymmetric', 'wakes patient' not linked to headache).
